params.message:
Readings in plain words: the writer gets the body rules, plain-edit replaces fable-polish

The house voice reached the trend writer for headlines only, so the four reading
fields came out as long abstract sentences. READING_VOICE (voice.mjs) now goes to
both writing paths in suggest.mjs. plain-edit.mjs rewrites the public readings with
the deepen model, meaning unchanged; checkPlainEdit (plain-check.mjs) refuses an edit
that adds a number, uses a banned word, a dash or bold, or grows. Dry by default,
every write kept in plain_edit_undo, --undo puts it back. fable-polish.mjs asked for
a deeper reading and wrote it unchecked; it goes.
